metadata.user_constraint_scope: C>0.4 at 50 MHz only; no linewidth or contrast regression vs original across 5--60 MHz
metadata.guardrail_scope: Center <=2 kHz, satellite prominence <=0.01, final P2 <=0.005; separate from user constraints
metadata.contrast_definition: Absolute dip depth below a linear background at |detuning|>=0.4MHz within +-0.5MHz
metadata.fixed_offset_depth_definition:
Unfitted depth from fixed ±offset probabilities to the central raw minimum.

    The center is the sampled minimum within ±0.25 MHz. The conservative depth
    uses the lower of P(-offset) and P(+offset), with linear interpolation only
    when an offset is between samples. This is separate from primary contrast.
metadata.amplitude_definition: Maximum absolute completed I-iQ waveform, with derivative correction
